events.title: Tarot With Andre
events.description: Step into an evening of insight, symbolism, and possibility with Tarot with Andre . Whether you are seeking clarity around relationships, career, timing, personal growth, or simply feel drawn to explore what is unfolding beneath the surface, Andre’s readings are thoughtful, intuitive, and deeply grounded. Tarot has been used for centuries as a tool for reflection, guidance, and self-discovery. The earliest tarot decks appeared in 15th-century Italy , originally created as elaborate card games for the nobility. Over time, the imagery of the cards evolved into a rich symbolic language connected to archetypes, intuition, and the journey of the human experience. By the 18th and 19th centuries, tarot began to be used as a spiritual and intuitive practice, helping people better understand the energies, choices, and patterns present in their lives. Each card in the tarot deck carries layers of meaning. The Major Arcana explores the deeper themes and turning points of life, while the Minor Arcana often reflects the everyday situations, emotions, relationships, and decisions we encounter. A reading is not about predicting a fixed future—it is about illuminating what is present now, what may be influencing you, and where your path could lead depending on the choices you make. Andre creates a warm, welcoming space where messages can unfold naturally and without judgment. His readings often combine intuition, symbolism, and practical guidance, helping you leave with a clearer understanding of your circumstances and a deeper connection to your own inner knowing. Whether you are new to tarot or have been receiving readings for years, this experience offers the chance to pause, reflect, and reconnect with yourself in a meaningful way.
